The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (2.00%) for the intermeeting period.

Monetary Policy Decision
Domestic economic activity has shown a recovering trend thanks to the progress of global economic situation.

(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (2.00%) for the intermeeting period.
Consumer price inflation has continued stable, influenced by the appreciation of the Korean won against the US dollar.
The upward trend of real estate prices appears to have faltered.
Domestic economic activity has shown a recovering trend thanks to the progress of global economic situation.
Exports, domestic demand and production have improved further.

In the financial markets, the volatility of price variables such as stock prices and interest rates has expanded somewhat while the growth of mortgage lending has continued to flatten out due to the expansion of the areas where debt-to-income ratios are applied and higher lending rates.
There still remains, however, uncertainty as to the economic growth path.
Looking ahead, the Committee will maintain the accommodative policy stance for the time being with an emphasis on sustaining the recovery of economic activity.
